redirects:
Options -Indexes
DirectoryIndex index.html
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
</IfModule>
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
<IfModule mod_filter.c>
AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css text/javascript application/javascript image/svg+xml
</IfModule>
</IfModule>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.damvi\.ru$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ https://damvi.ru%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,END]
RewriteRule ^_pages(?:/|$) - [R=404,END]
RewriteRule ^services/support/?$ /services/seo-blog [R=301,END]
RewriteRule ^api/contact/?$ api/contact.php [END]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f [OR]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^ - [END]
RewriteRule ^api/ - [R=404,END]
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/_pages/$1.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.+?)/?$ _pages/$1.html [END]
ErrorDocument 404 /404.html
RewriteRule ^ - [R=404,END]
